concerns.text: T017b [P] is marked parallel-safe but depends on T016's atomic file commit. T016 performs a two-pass streaming write to `standardized.csv` and generates `markov_state.json`. T017b reads `markov_state.json` to validate `order=1`. If T016 has not finished its atomic commit, T017b will fail or read partial data. A task reading a file produced by another task cannot be parallel-safe ([P]) relative to that producer.

T028 [P] is marked parallel-safe but explicitly depends on T023, T024, T025, T026, and T023b to consume their results from `analysis/results.json`. The description states: 'Must run sequentially after T023-T026 to consume results.' A task that consumes artifacts from multiple prior tasks cannot be parallel-safe ([P]) relative to those producers.

T017 (Generate standardized CSV) and T017b (Save transition tables) both depend on T016. T017 writes `standardized.csv` while T017b reads `markov_state.json` (produced by T016). While T017 and T017b might be parallel to each other, T017b is listed as [P] in the list but has a hard dependency on T016's completion. The [P] tag on T017b is misleading if it implies it can run before T016 finishes.

T012c [P] is marked parallel-safe but has a dependency on T012b ('Dep: T012b'). T012c reads the exclusion log generated by T012b. A task that reads an artifact produced by a predecessor cannot be parallel-safe relative to that predecessor.
